sum: Velos Acquisition I Corp. does not have significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was formerly known as M3-Brigade Acquisition V Corp. and changed its name to Velos Acquisition I Corp. in July 2026. Velos Acquisition I Corp. was incorporated in 2024 and is based in New York, New York.
